title: Does Feature Absorption Worsen When Decoding Concepts the Model Learned Late?

original_idea.body: Feature absorption vs learning order idea

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Predictable absorption gives an SAE-reliability heuristic (plausible chain) but the catastrophic-risk link is several steps removed.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Combining absorption measurement, corpus frequency, and checkpoint learnability proxies needs solid ML; intermediate.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused correlation deliverable but assembling absorption + frequency + learning-order proxies is moderately multi-workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Entirely open resources; SAE-reliability auditing is independent-friendly and labs underweight it.

low_compute.reasoning: Open SAEs + Pythia checkpoint inference; modest compute, no training.

novelty.reasoning: Absorption mechanism known; correlating with frequency/learning order may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Absorption is documented but its predictability from concept frequency/learning order may be open.
